scope: Same weights and scoring, only adapter activation timing differs. Repeated development seeds; no independent generalization claim.

immediate.scope: Scene selected by scene_base with the recorded initial_skill. With pass initialization, a static shooting ball is sampled after observed pass plus recovery delay; shoot initialization is only a scene diagnostic. First-observed impact diagnostics; no robot/history reset at handoff. Failed lanes never re-enter counting; original per-task quality metrics are not reused for second ball.
